# pve_mapping_dir (Data Source)

Reads a single directory hardware mapping (`GET /cluster/mapping/dir/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_mapping_dir" "share" {
  id = "share"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the directory mapping to read.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the directory mapping.
- `map` (Attributes List) Per-node directory entries of the mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--map))

<a id="nestedatt--map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `map`

Read-Only:

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `path` (String) Absolute directory path on the node.
